title: Where should the Mark III's learning upgrades be bought: the seed box or the workbench?
question:
The Mark III is the robot that learns by trial and reward, and the one you asked Milo to sketch a shop for: new brains, new ways of training, special examples for the robot to learn from, and examples you make yourself. Milo's sketch lays out twelve options with Kenji's notes on what the game can already do; these cards carry its open questions, one per card. Nothing is recommended, because you said you have ideas of your own.

Where does a learning purchase happen? Every other machine is bought at the seed box. Everything else about training a Mark III already lives at the workbench, where nothing is bought today.

If you have shapes for this shop that aren't in the sketch, say so in your comment on this card.
why_now: You asked Milo for this sketch in HQ's chat on 2026-09-25. It landed as commit 4f6ae2f; nothing gets built until you answer.

options.label: At the seed box, like every other purchase
options.detail: Learning upgrades sit on the same shelf as machines and seeds, so there is one place to buy things.

options.label: At the workbench, beside the robot's training
options.detail: The purchase sits where the player already tunes what the robot is paid for; the workbench gains a small shelf of its own.

options.label: Not decided until one upgrade exists
options.detail: Leave this open until the first learning upgrade is chosen and built.

links.label: Milo's sketch of the Mark III learning shop

subject: The Mark III learning shop

ruled.summary: Ruled 2026-09-25: (b) Mark III learning upgrades are bought from a small shelf at the training workbench, not the seed box. Recorded as S-29 (8d7366d); nothing is built yet.
